cmp.onboarding.step1.title: Launch the game
cmp.onboarding.step1.body: This is the launcher home page. Pick an installed version from the dropdown, adjust the memory, then click "Launch" to enter the game. The required files are downloaded automatically on first launch.
cmp.onboarding.step2.title: Resources · Mods
cmp.onboarding.step2.body: This is the download center, split into "Mods / Resource Packs / Shaders / Modpacks / Versions". Take mods as an example: they add new content or change gameplay. Most mods rely on a "loader" to run.
cmp.onboarding.step3.title: Instances & loaders
cmp.onboarding.step3.body: Each "instance" is an independent game installation (vanilla + loader + mods). A loader (such as Fabric, Forge, Quilt, NeoForge) is the framework mods need to run. When installing an instance you can pick the matching loader; if you choose Fabric you can also check Fabric API to install it as well.
cmp.onboarding.step4.title: Accounts
cmp.onboarding.step4.body: Click here to sign in with a Microsoft account or a third-party account (such as LittleSkin / Chanmao Auth Center) to play online; you can also play offline without signing in.
cmp.onboarding.step5.title: Install vanilla 26.2
cmp.onboarding.step5.body: Let's install a new instance. Click "Go to install" and we will pre-fill version 26.2 under "Resources → Versions"; select that version there and press "Install" (you can check Fabric API when choosing Fabric).
cmp.onboarding.step6.title: Reopen this guide
cmp.onboarding.step6.body: That's the end of the guide. To see it again later, just double-click the "HungerCat MineCraft Launcher icon" at the top left to reopen this onboarding guide.
